record_title: Automatic odd parts for the cubic, fifth and ninth Thue-Morse powers
scientific_context: Proves Shen's automatic-odd-part conjecture for the previously uncovered exponents m=3, 5, and 9. The fifth- and ninth-power cases are obtained by normalizing known block recurrences by exact 2-adic valuations and reducing the resulting valuation-depth recurrences modulo fixed powers of two.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result treats only m=3,5,9 and does not settle the all-exponent conjecture; m=7 remains unresolved among exponents at most 9. Xinping Wang's May 2026 undergraduate thesis was not fully inspected and is the principal source-access originality risk. The motivating September 2026 conjecture paper is very recent, so unindexed concurrent work remains possible. The finite computation is corroborative only. No independent validation, independent audit, or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the cubic identities, the published fifth- and ninth-power valuation formulas on finite ranges, and the normalized recurrences.
